svg.title: Groundskeeper identity and role boundary
svg.desc: GitHub OAuth issues an eight-hour secure session after installation allowlist checks. Only session hashes are stored. Every request checks current membership and role. Viewers read reviews; reviewers and admins save reviews. Admin browser changes and operator bootstrap share the same locked membership engine, version checks, last-admin protection and audit history.
